name: User Session
description: JWT access/refresh issuance + revocation, Redis-backed session cache, CRUD on UserSession rows.
author: Kuray Karaaslan

extensionPoints.description: Told after sessions are deleted (logout, sign out other devices, log out everywhere, password change, account deletion), with [{ userSessionId, userId, tenantId, sessionEndOrderedBy? }]; sessionEndOrderedBy (D249) names the modules whose session_end:order_source orders for that session were already recorded in the revoking transaction, whose hooks skip it. Default export: (revoked) => Promise<void>. For data bound to a session that must not outlive it — notification_push removes a native app's push token, which otherwise keeps delivering the account's notifications to a phone nobody is signed in on. Best-effort by contract: a hook that throws is logged and skipped, revoking a session must never fail because a satellite's cleanup had trouble. Sessions that merely expire are not announced.
